edits.reason: Say: 'Here a resistance breaks, and on the way back price retests it as support.' The break is the explicitly-taught event that precedes the retest-as-support, but accumulated show only has level + the retest marker. breakout(pt) is a valid sr_flip anchor; marker matches the point type. Marking it makes the chart teach the full break->retest sequence the voice describes.

noAnchorGaps.concept: Buying pullbacks into support (the support being hunted)
noAnchorGaps.quote: we want to buy pullbacks into support, not chase the highs
noAnchorGaps.why: move uptrend exposes only start/high1/hl1/hl2/hh1/hh2 (pt) and flipLevel(L) — no 'support' anchor; the tradeable support level is established on the next sr_flip chart, so there is no valid anchor here

noAnchorGaps.concept: The candle printing right at the S/R level
noAnchorGaps.quote: A long lower wick right at the level is exactly what we want
noAnchorGaps.why: move long_lower_wick exposes only low(pt), body(pt) and the lowerWick/body/upperWick regions — no level anchor to mark 'the level'; level context belongs to the surrounding sr_flip / trade_setup_long charts

notes: Accepted the auditor's high-confidence sr_flip 'breakout' marker (changed style sweep->dot: there is no sweep here, a resistance break is best shown as a plain dot above the level). REJECTED the auditor's proposed hl2 'higher low' marker on the structure beat: the HH/HL pattern is already taught by the accumulated hl1 'higher low' + hh1 'higher high' + hh2 'bias = long' markers, so a second 'higher low' is over-annotation (auditor self-rated it low confidence). Confirmed both noAnchorGaps are genuine — uptrend has no support anchor and long_lower_wick has no level anchor. plan and play beats are fully and correctly annotated against trade_setup_long anchors (entry/stop/target levels + risk/reward zones, plus the play target-reached marker); the 'holds the level / never threatens the stop' references in play map to entry/stop already accumulated from the plan beat (same chart), so no gap.
